svg.title: Spead AI: before and after
svg.desc: Before: Search shared drives and ask colleagues for the right file. After: Ask the assistant and open the cited page of the source document. Before: Paste confidential files into a public AI chat. After: Answers come only from documents the asker may open, inside the company workspace. Before: Read two vendor contracts side by side to spot differences. After: Doc Assistant builds a comparison table where every cell links to its source. Before: Copy an old letter, fix the letterhead, number and signature by hand. After: Document Studio fills a company template with locked letterhead, automatic numbering and a signing route. Before: Access rules live in people's heads. After: Labels link documents to positions, and admins can preview what any position can see. Before: Automations act without anyone noticing. After: Any action that sends or changes data waits for a person to allow it.
